table.name: TLGNR_DELIV_NOTE_SAREA_TEXT_TX
table.description: Texts which are meant to be configurable by the administrator, for generated PDF documents. Changes of the TXT for a given TEXT_CD are possible independent of releases.

column.name: DELIV_NOTE_SAREA_TEXT_CD
column.description: Part of PK. FK to TLGNR_TEXT_BS. Code of the Reference Data.

column.name: LANG_CD
column.description: Part of PK. Non-enforced FK to TLGNR_LANG_BS.

column.name: TXT
column.description: Text resource in the language LANG_CD. tlgnr_text_bs.placeholder_count defines the number of placeholders of type {x} which must be present in the text.
